about: The fixed contract of the COTE encyclopedia. Every page, index, rail count, citation label and search record is built from entity records that follow this file. Adding a character, volume, exam, system, place or topic means adding its data row (and its ledger, once read); no builder code has to change. docs/SCHEMA.md is the human-readable version of this file.

character.id_format: characters.char_id — lowercase ascii family-given, hyphenated; permanent
character.source: cote_kb.db characters (one row per name) + ledgers/people/<stem>.md (evidence)
character.url_rule: band 1 or 2 gets a page; band 3 is an entry on the page for its initial
character.sort_key: family name, accent-folded, then given name
character.sort_rule: alphabetical by sort_key on every list that is not band-grouped

volume.source: cote_kb.db volumes (id, title, chrono_order, kind, pages) + ledgers/volumes/<id>.md
volume.sort_key: chrono_order (numeric, so 4.5 and 7.5 sort between 4 and 5, 7 and 8)

exam.source: cote_kb.db exams + exam_instances (which volume ran it) + ledgers/exams/<stem>.md
exam.sort_key: chrono_order of the first volume that runs it

topic.id_format: topics/<id>.html — a fixed question page, not a data row
topic.source: ledger entries that answer the question (kb/site_topics.py)

scene.id_format: ev-<vol>-p<first>-<last>-<order> (order = position of the block inside its volume section)
scene.url: anchored inside the page that renders the ledger (<volume page>, <character page>, <exam page>, <place page>)

source.id_format: same as volumes.vol_id — the printed volume a citation points into
source.label: Year <year>, Volume <number>
source.role: The one table every citation, appearance row and label reads. Generator code never types a volume name.

entity_fields.display_name: the one spelling shown in title, H1, breadcrumb, link text and body
entity_fields.aliases: every other spelling; search and redirects only
entity_fields.sort_key: the key every generated list sorts by
entity_fields.type: one of the keys of types
entity_fields.tier: presence band for characters (1 principal, 2 medium, 3 minor)
entity_fields.parents: year / class / section the record belongs to

status_rules.character: stub = no scene blocks; partial = scene blocks exist but a volume the name appears in has not been read through; complete = scene blocks exist and every volume the name appears in carries its DONE stamp
status_rules.volume: stub = no scenes and no chapter ledger; partial = some scenes or chapters; complete = the volume ledger carries its DONE stamp
status_rules.exam: stub = no ledger; partial = ledger scenes exist; complete = ledger scenes exist and every volume that runs it is DONE
status_rules.system: stub = no ledger; partial = ledger scenes exist; complete = ledger scenes exist and every volume the ledger cites is DONE
status_rules.place: stub = no ledger; partial = ledger scenes exist; complete = ledger scenes exist and every volume the ledger cites is DONE
status_rules.topic: partial = a source volume is not read through; complete = every source volume is read through

bands.rule: a name leaves the minor pool when its ledger crosses medium_min in either count, or the curated tier already calls it higher; no count demotes a curated tier

markers.required: every ledger marker resolves to a reader label; the build fails on an unknown one

validation: every page has exactly one h1 and unique element ids
every internal link and anchor resolves
every entity has display_name, sort_key and a unique id
no two entities share an alias
entity link text equals the target display_name
section order identical in tab bar, home, footer and indexes
no left-rail link duplicates a tab-bar link
every rail count equals the number of items rendered in the body
every list is sorted by its declared key
every ledger marker has a reader label
no page has more than one layout for its type
a redirect exists for every changed URL
